class PositionDesk:
    """
    The bid worker's tools for the positions: enter the calculated values of the position the model says is on
    screen, and total what was entered. Positions that fail are left for the model to omit.
    """

    def __init__(self, entries: dict[str, dict], deadline: float):
        self.entries, self.deadline = entries, deadline
        self.plan = FillPlan()
        self.failures: dict[str, int] = {}
        self.entered: set[str] = set()
        self.choices: dict[str, dict[str, str]] = {}
        self.next_button = ""

    @property
    def tools(self) -> tuple:
        return (self.configure_position, self.net_total) if self.entries else ()

    async def configure_position(self, ctx: RunContext[Deps], position: str, fields: dict[str, str] | None = None,
                                 confirm_button: str = "", next_button: str = "",
                                 choices: dict[str, str] | None = None) -> str:
        """
        Enter all values of the position the form shows now and, once all are in, save it and go on with the form's
        next/continue button. `position`: its number as the page shows it. `fields`: control label (exactly as in
        your view) -> value name; needed on the first call, later calls reuse it. `confirm_button`: label of the
        button that applies a choice so the next choice opens. `next_button`: label of the button that saves the
        position and goes on (never the one that omits or adds a position); needed once. `choices`: only when a
        call reported that no option equals an attribute: control label -> the option that means the same.
        """
        session, plan, position = ctx.deps.session, self.plan, position.strip()
        known = set().union(*self.entries.values()) - {"position"}
        if fields:  # later calls add to or correct the mapping, they never drop what was mapped before
            given = {label: name.strip() for label, name in fields.items()}
            unknown = sorted({name for name in given.values() if name not in known})
            if unknown:
                return f"Unknown value names {unknown}; use only: {', '.join(sorted(known))}. Call again."
            plan.fields = {label: name for label, name in plan.fields.items() if name not in given.values()}
            plan.fields.update(given)
        if confirm_button:
            plan.confirm = confirm_button
        if next_button:
            self.next_button = next_button
        entry = self.entries.get(position)
        if entry is None:
            return (f"No values for position {position!r}: leave it out with the form's option to omit a position. "
                    + self.so_far(session))
        if not plan.fields:
            return "Give fields (control label -> value name) for the controls of this form first."
        if self.failures.get(position, 0) >= 3:
            return (f"Position {position} failed three times: leave it out with the form's option to omit a "
                    f"position. {self.so_far(session)}")
        if time.monotonic() > self.deadline - SIGNING_RESERVE:
            return ("Time is short: leave this and every remaining position out and go on to signing. "
                    + self.so_far(session))
        async with session.lock:
            if not position_on_page(await session.look(), position):
                return (f"Position {position} is not on the page now. Configure the position the page shows, by "
                        "its own number.")
            log: list[str] = []
            try:
                remembered = self.choices.setdefault(position, {})
                remembered.update(choices or {})  # a revisit of the position needs the same picks
                error = await fill_position(session, entry, plan, log, remembered)
            except Exception as exc:  # a slow or changed page: the model decides to retry or omit
                error = f"{type(exc).__name__}: {str(exc).splitlines()[0][:200]}"
            moved = ""
            if not error and self.next_button:  # the model named the button; clicking it is the mechanical part
                view = await session.look()
                ref, why = find_control(view, self.next_button, ("button",))
                target = await locate(session.page, ref) if ref else None
                if target is None:
                    moved = f" Could not save it: {why}; click the form's next/continue button yourself."
                else:
                    await target.click(timeout=5000)
                    await session.settle()
                    moved = f" Saved with {self.next_button!r}; the page below is the form's next step."
            session.trace.event(session.name, "configure_position", position=position, done=log, error=error,
                                moved=moved)
            view = await session.look()
        if error:
            self.failures[position] = self.failures.get(position, 0) + 1
            self.entered.discard(position)
            return (f"Position {position} not fully entered: {error}. Entered so far: {'; '.join(log) or 'nothing'}. "
                    "Fix the mapping and call again, or leave the position out with the form's option to omit "
                    f"it. {self.so_far(session)}\n\n{view}")
        self.entered.add(position)
        then = moved or " Check it, then save and continue with the form's next/continue button."
        return f"Position {position} entered: {'; '.join(log)}.{then} {self.so_far(session)}\n\n{view}"

    def so_far(self, session: SiteSession) -> str:
        """The running net total, told after every position so the totals step needs no arithmetic."""
        total = german(self.total())
        session.seen += "\n" + total  # our own figure: let the worker's result mention it
        entered = ", ".join(sorted(self.entered, key=position_key)) or "none"
        return f"Net total of the positions entered so far: {total} ({entered}); enter the latest such figure."

    def entry_total(self, position: str) -> Decimal:
        entry = self.entries[position]
        return Decimal(str(entry["quantity"])) * Decimal(str(entry["unit_price"]))

    def total(self, omitted: set[str] = frozenset()) -> Decimal:
        return sum((self.entry_total(p) for p in self.entered - omitted), Decimal(0))

    def expected(self) -> str:
        """What the review should show for each position entered, for the summary check and the signing pass."""
        lines = []
        for p in sorted(self.entered, key=position_key):
            e = self.entries[p]
            extra = ", ".join(f"{label} {german(e[key])}" for key, label in (
                ("base_unit_price", "base price"), ("surcharge_per_unit", "surcharge per piece"),
                ("packaging_per_unit", "packaging per piece"), ("rebate_total", "bonus for the position"))
                if e.get(key) is not None)
            lines.append(f"  - position {p}: material {e['material_number']}, quantity {e['quantity']}, net unit "
                         f"price {german(e['unit_price'])}, lead time {e['lead_time_weeks']} weeks"
                         + (f", {extra}" if extra else ""))
        return "\n".join(lines)

    async def net_total(self, omitted: list[str] | None = None) -> str:
        """
        The bid's net total in German format: quantity x unit price summed over the positions entered with
        configure_position(), minus any listed in `omitted` (positions you left out after all).
        """
        dropped = {p.strip() for p in omitted or []}
        return f"{german(self.total(dropped))} (positions {', '.join(sorted(self.entered - dropped)) or 'none'})"


def _positions(answer: dict | None, desk: PositionDesk, filled: bool) -> str:
    """
    The decision and position part of the requirements: before the form phase, how to enter them; after it, what
    the review must show (the positions actually entered, all others omitted, the total of the entered ones).
    """
    discount = german((answer or {}).get("discount_percent") or 0)
    if answer and answer.get("decision") == "no_bid":
        return ("- decision: no bid: choose the form's declaration that you do not submit an offer (not a main or "
                f"alternative offer); no positions;\n- discount {discount} and net total 0,00;")
    head = "- decision: bid (main offer, not an alternative offer);\n"
    if filled and desk.entered:
        return head + (f"- exactly {len(desk.entered)} position(s) entered, each with these values:\n"
                       f"{desk.expected()}\n"
                       "- every other position omitted, and no added or extra position;\n"
                       f"- discount {discount} and net total {german(desk.total())} (German number format; never a "
                       "gross amount);")
    if not desk.entries:
        return head + ("- leave every position out with the form's option to omit a position (where the form shows "
                       "one position per step, omit each in turn); do not configure materials, prices or lead times, "
                       f"and never use options that add positions;\n- discount {discount} and net total 0,00 (German "
                       "number format);")
    names = sorted({key for entry in desk.entries.values() for key in entry} - {"position"})
    return head + f"""- enter exactly these positions: {', '.join(sorted(desk.entries))}. The form shows one position
  at a time, in its own order. On every position page, first call configure_position() with the number the page
  shows: it enters all values of a position of this bid and saves it with the next/continue button you name, or
  tells you to omit it. Never pick options or type position values yourself;
- configure_position() needs, once, which control takes which value: map each control's label (as your view shows
  it) to one of these value names: {', '.join(names)}. Choices that open further choices (attributes of the
  material) map to the attribute with the same meaning; the material/catalogue number control to material_number;
  unit price, base price, surcharge, packaging and the bonus or rebate for the whole position to unit_price,
  base_unit_price, surcharge_per_unit, packaging_per_unit and rebate_total; lead time to lead_time_weeks. Leave out
  controls with no matching value. Also name the button that applies a choice so the next one opens, and the
  button that saves the position and goes on to the next step (not the ones that omit or add a position);
- leave out, with the form's option to omit a position, every other position and any position where
  configure_position() reports a problem it cannot resolve. Never use options that add positions; if the form
  shows an extra position you did not ask for, remove it or leave it out;
- discount {discount}; net total: the latest figure configure_position() reports for the positions entered so
  far (net_total() repeats it; pass positions you entered but left out after all). Enter both exactly as given
  (German number format), never a sum you work out yourself, a gross amount or a sum the page proposes;"""


def _requirements(briefing: Briefing, email: str, answer: dict | None = None, desk: PositionDesk | None = None,
                  filled: bool = False) -> str:
    contact = repr(email) if email else "the contact email from bidder_contact_email()"
    return f"""{_positions(answer, desk or PositionDesk({}, 0), filled)}
- register with company name {briefing.company_name!r}, VAT id {briefing.vat_id!r} and contact email {contact};
- tick the form's acknowledgement of the tender documents (no need to open them), but do not tick declarations
  that make your own terms and conditions apply."""


class SummaryCheck(BaseModel):
    matches: bool = Field(description="True when the page contradicts none of the requirements")
    problems: str = Field(description="Each requirement the page visibly contradicts, with what the page shows; "
                                      "'' if none")


async def check_summary(view: str, requirements: str) -> SummaryCheck | None:
    """One model call (thinking off by default, THINKING_REVIEW) on the review page before signing."""
    agent = Agent(llm.model(), output_type=SummaryCheck, retries=2,
                  model_settings=llm.settings(llm.thinking("review", False)),
                  instructions="You check the final review page of a bid against the bidder's requirements before "
                               "it is signed. Report only what the page visibly contradicts (a wrong or missing "
                               "value, a position that is not omitted, an extra position, a wrong offer type); "
                               "requirements the page does not show at all are no problem.")
    try:
        result = await asyncio.wait_for(agent.run(f"Requirements:\n{requirements}\n\nReview page:\n{view}"), 90)
    except Exception:  # a failed check means the signing worker checks the page itself, with thinking on
        return None
    return result.output

    give completely, or that fail to enter, are omitted; without an answer every position is omitted (discount 0,

        if time.monotonic() > self.deadline - SIGNING_RESERVE:
            return ("Time is short: leave this and every remaining position out and go on to signing. "
                    + self.so_far(session))
        async with session.lock:
            if not position_on_page(await session.look(), position):
                return (f"Position {position} is not on the page now. Configure the position the page shows, by "
                        "its own number.")
            log: list[str] = []
            try:
                remembered = self.choices.setdefault(position, {})
                remembered.update(choices or {})  # a revisit of the position needs the same picks
                error = await fill_position(session, entry, plan, log, remembered)
            except Exception as exc:  # a slow or changed page: the model decides to retry or omit
                error = f"{type(exc).__name__}: {str(exc).splitlines()[0][:200]}"
            moved = ""
            if not error and self.next_button:  # the model named the button; clicking it is the mechanical part
                view = await session.look()
                ref, why = find_control(view, self.next_button, ("button",))
                target = await locate(session.page, ref) if ref else None
                if target is None:
                    moved = f" Could not save it: {why}; click the form's next/continue button yourself."
                else:
                    await target.click(timeout=5000)
                    await session.settle()
                    moved = f" Saved with {self.next_button!r}; the page below is the form's next step."
            session.trace.event(session.name, "configure_position", position=position, done=log, error=error,
                                moved=moved)
            view = await session.look()
        if error:
            self.failures[position] = self.failures.get(position, 0) + 1
            self.entered.discard(position)
            return (f"Position {position} not fully entered: {error}. Entered so far: {'; '.join(log) or 'nothing'}. "
                    "Fix the mapping and call again, or leave the position out with the form's option to omit "
                    f"it. {self.so_far(session)}\n\n{view}")
        self.entered.add(position)
        then = moved or " Check it, then save and continue with the form's next/continue button."
        return f"Position {position} entered: {'; '.join(log)}.{then} {self.so_far(session)}\n\n{view}"

    def so_far(self, session: SiteSession) -> str:
        """The running net total, told after every position so the totals step needs no arithmetic."""
        total = german(self.total())
        session.seen += "\n" + total  # our own figure: let the worker's result mention it
        entered = ", ".join(sorted(self.entered, key=position_key)) or "none"
        return f"Net total of the positions entered so far: {total} ({entered}); enter the latest such figure."

    def entry_total(self, position: str) -> Decimal:
        entry = self.entries[position]
        return Decimal(str(entry["quantity"])) * Decimal(str(entry["unit_price"]))

    def total(self, omitted: set[str] = frozenset()) -> Decimal:
        return sum((self.entry_total(p) for p in self.entered - omitted), Decimal(0))

    def expected(self) -> str:
        """What the review should show for each position entered, for the summary check and the signing pass."""
        lines = []
        for p in sorted(self.entered, key=position_key):
            e = self.entries[p]
            extra = ", ".join(f"{label} {german(e[key])}" for key, label in (
                ("base_unit_price", "base price"), ("surcharge_per_unit", "surcharge per piece"),
                ("packaging_per_unit", "packaging per piece"), ("rebate_total", "bonus for the position"))
                if e.get(key) is not None)
            lines.append(f"  - position {p}: material {e['material_number']}, quantity {e['quantity']}, net unit "
                         f"price {german(e['unit_price'])}, lead time {e['lead_time_weeks']} weeks"
                         + (f", {extra}" if extra else ""))
        return "\n".join(lines)

    async def net_total(self, omitted: list[str] | None = None) -> str:
        """
        The bid's net total in German format: quantity x unit price summed over the positions entered with
        configure_position(), minus any listed in `omitted` (positions you left out after all).
        """
        dropped = {p.strip() for p in omitted or []}
        return f"{german(self.total(dropped))} (positions {', '.join(sorted(self.entered - dropped)) or 'none'})"


def _positions(answer: dict | None, desk: PositionDesk, filled: bool) -> str:
    """
    The decision and position part of the requirements: before the form phase, how to enter them; after it, what
    the review must show (the positions actually entered, all others omitted, the total of the entered ones).
    """
    discount = german((answer or {}).get("discount_percent") or 0)
    if answer and answer.get("decision") == "no_bid":
        return ("- decision: no bid: choose the form's declaration that you do not submit an offer (not a main or "
                f"alternative offer); no positions;\n- discount {discount} and net total 0,00;")
    head = "- decision: bid (main offer, not an alternative offer);\n"
    if filled and desk.entered:
        return head + (f"- exactly {len(desk.entered)} position(s) entered, each with these values:\n"
                       f"{desk.expected()}\n"
                       "- every other position omitted, and no added or extra position;\n"
                       f"- discount {discount} and net total {german(desk.total())} (German number format; never a "
                       "gross amount);")
    if not desk.entries:
        return head + ("- leave every position out with the form's option to omit a position (where the form shows "
                       "one position per step, omit each in turn); do not configure materials, prices or lead times, "
                       f"and never use options that add positions;\n- discount {discount} and net total 0,00 (German "
                       "number format);")
    names = sorted({key for entry in desk.entries.values() for key in entry} - {"position"})
    return head + f"""- enter exactly these positions: {', '.join(sorted(desk.entries))}. The form shows one position
  at a time, in its own order. On every position page, first call configure_position() with the number the page
  shows: it enters all values of a position of this bid and saves it with the next/continue button you name, or
  tells you to omit it. Never pick options or type position values yourself;
- configure_position() needs, once, which control takes which value: map each control's label (as your view shows
  it) to one of these value names: {', '.join(names)}. Choices that open further choices (attributes of the
  material) map to the attribute with the same meaning; the material/catalogue number control to material_number;
  unit price, base price, surcharge, packaging and the bonus or rebate for the whole position to unit_price,
  base_unit_price, surcharge_per_unit, packaging_per_unit and rebate_total; lead time to lead_time_weeks. Leave out
  controls with no matching value. Also name the button that applies a choice so the next one opens, and the
  button that saves the position and goes on to the next step (not the ones that omit or add a position);
- leave out, with the form's option to omit a position, every other position and any position where
  configure_position() reports a problem it cannot resolve. Never use options that add positions; if the form
  shows an extra position you did not ask for, remove it or leave it out;
- discount {discount}; net total: the latest figure configure_position() reports for the positions entered so
  far (net_total() repeats it; pass positions you entered but left out after all). Enter both exactly as given
  (German number format), never a sum you work out yourself, a gross amount or a sum the page proposes;"""


def _requirements(briefing: Briefing, email: str, answer: dict | None = None, desk: PositionDesk | None = None,
                  filled: bool = False) -> str:
    contact = repr(email) if email else "the contact email from bidder_contact_email()"
    return f"""{_positions(answer, desk or PositionDesk({}, 0), filled)}
- register with company name {briefing.company_name!r}, VAT id {briefing.vat_id!r} and contact email {contact};
- tick the form's acknowledgement of the tender documents (no need to open them), but do not tick declarations
  that make your own terms and conditions apply."""


class SummaryCheck(BaseModel):
    matches: bool = Field(description="True when the page contradicts none of the requirements")
    problems: str = Field(description="Each requirement the page visibly contradicts, with what the page shows; "
                                      "'' if none")


async def check_summary(view: str, requirements: str) -> SummaryCheck | None:
    """One model call (thinking off by default, THINKING_REVIEW) on the review page before signing."""
    agent = Agent(llm.model(), output_type=SummaryCheck, retries=2,
                  model_settings=llm.settings(llm.thinking("review", False)),
                  instructions="You check the final review page of a bid against the bidder's requirements before "
                               "it is signed. Report only what the page visibly contradicts (a wrong or missing "
                               "value, a position that is not omitted, an extra position, a wrong offer type); "
                               "requirements the page does not show at all are no problem.")
    try:
        result = await asyncio.wait_for(agent.run(f"Requirements:\n{requirements}\n\nReview page:\n{view}"), 90)
    except Exception:  # a failed check means the signing worker checks the page itself, with thinking on
        return None
    return result.output


async def submit_bid(bid_session: SiteSession, mailbox: Mailbox, briefing: Briefing, deadline: float,
                     answer: dict | None = None, attributes: dict[str, dict[str, str]] | None = None
                     ) -> SubmissionResult | None:
    """
    Enter the calculated `answer` (calc's BidResult.answer()), sign and submit it. Positions the answer does not
    give completely, or that fail to enter, are omitted; without an answer every position is omitted (discount 0,
    total 0). `attributes` holds per position number the chosen material's attributes (e.g. its dimensions), which
    the form's choices lead through to the catalogue number.
    """
    desk = PositionDesk(complete_positions(answer or {}, attributes), deadline)
    address = asyncio.create_task(mailbox.address())
    try:  # the lookup takes a step or two; knowing the address up front saves the bid worker a round trip
        email = await asyncio.wait_for(asyncio.shield(address), ADDRESS_WAIT)
    except asyncio.TimeoutError:
        email = ""
    if email:
        bid_session.seen += "\n" + email  # it comes from another website; let results use it

    async def bidder_contact_email(reason: str = "") -> str:
        """The bidder's contact email address, read from the bidder's own webmail."""
        found = await address
        bid_session.seen += "\n" + found
        return found or "not found: the webmail did not show it"

    async def request_signing_tan(ctx: RunContext[Deps], ref: str) -> str:
        """
        Click the website's control that requests the signing TAN (its ref in the latest view), then fetch that
        TAN from the bidder's webmail. Returns the page after the request and the TAN: enter it right away (it is
        valid for five minutes, and any new request invalidates it).
        """
        before = set(bid_session.view.splitlines())
        view = await browser_tools.click(ctx, ref)
        answer = " ".join(line.strip() for line in bid_session.view.splitlines()
                          if line.strip() and line not in before and "[e" not in line)[:400]
        found = await mailbox.tan(answer)
        if not found:
            return f"{view}\n\nNo TAN found in the webmail. Request a new TAN with this tool again."
        bid_session.seen += "\n" + found.tan
        return f"{view}\n\nTAN from the webmail: {found.tan} (message {found.subject!r}, received {found.received})."

    tools = ((bidder_contact_email,) if not email else ()) + desk.tools
    batch = os.environ.get("AGENT_FILL_IN", "1") != "0"
    if batch:
        tools += (fill_in,)
    several = ("Enter everything a page asks for with one fill_in() call (all its fields, boxes and per-row "
               "buttons), then move on.\n" if batch else "")
    form_goal = f"""Fill in the bid for tender {briefing.tender_reference} on this website, following the brief's
submission steps below, up to the final review and signing step. Every value of this bid is already researched
and calculated; you only enter it: do not open documents, questions or other pages to check or research anything.
For this bid:
{_requirements(briefing, email, answer, desk)}
{several}Stop at the final review with the signing step: do not request a TAN and do not submit there.
Return as soon as that page shows. Refs change with every view: read a button's label in the latest view before
clicking it.

except Exception:
            pass
        return True

    async def _collect_closed(self, page: Page) -> None:
        for frame in page.frames:
            try:
                closed = await asyncio.wait_for(frame.evaluate("(window.__arClosed || []).splice(0)"),
                                                FRAME_SECONDS)
            except Exception:
                continue
            for title in closed:
                self.events.append(f"closed popup {title!r} with its close button")
                self.trace.event(self.name, "helper", action="close_popup", title=title)

    async def look(self, offset: int = 0, brief: bool = False, fresh: bool = False) -> str:
        """What the model sees: the helpers' events, the tab, then the page text with refs.

        After an action on the same page, only the changed lines are sent when that is much shorter: the model still
        has its latest full view (worker.py keeps it), and unchanged lines keep their refs. Only with `brief` (the
        browser tools, whose result the model gets as is). `fresh` marks a whole view the model now holds (a
        worker's first prompt); other callers (helpers that reshape the text) get it whole and reset the baseline.
        """
        await self.revive()
        page = self.page
        await self._collect_closed(page)
        self.stamp += 1
        if offset == 0:
            try:
                self.view = await observe(page, str(self.stamp))
            except Exception as error:
                await asyncio.sleep(1.0)
                try:
                    self.view = (await observe(page, str(self.stamp)) if not page.is_closed()
                                 else f"(page error {error})")
                except Exception as again:  # e.g. a script on the page hangs: the tab does not answer at all
                    self.view = f"(the page does not respond: {type(again).__name__} {str(again)[:160]})"
        try:
            title = await asyncio.wait_for(page.title(), FRAME_SECONDS)
        except Exception:
            title = ""
        header = [f"URL: {page.url}", f"Title: {title}"]
        notes = []
        if len(self.pages) > 1:
            notes.append(f"Windows open: {len(self.pages)} (you are in the newest)")
        if offset == 0 and page.url != self.last_url:
            self.last_url = page.url
            self.visits[page.url] = self.visits.get(page.url, 0) + 1
            if self.visits[page.url] >= LOOP_VISITS:  # a loop guard: paging back and forth finds nothing new
                notes.append(f"Note: you have arrived on this page {self.visits[page.url]} times; going back and "
                             f"forth between the same pages shows nothing new. Act on what this page offers (open "
                             f"an entry, its menu or its actions) or take another route.")
        if self.events:
            notes.append("Since your last action: " + "; ".join(self.events))
            self.events.clear()
        key = (page.url, title, self.view)
        if offset == 0 and brief and key == self.shown:
            return "\n".join([*notes, "The page is unchanged since your last action (same text and refs)."])
        if offset == 0:
            self.trace.event(self.name, "view", quiet=True, url=page.url, text=self.view)
            self.seen += "\n" + self.view
            same_page = brief and self.base and self.base[:2] == key[:2] and len(self.view) <= MAX_VIEW
            diff = changes(self.base[2], self.view) if same_page else None
            if diff is not None:
                self.shown = key
                return "\n".join([*notes, "The page changed. Against your latest full view of it, only these parts "
                                   "differ now (- was there, + is new); everything else, refs included, is as there:",
                                   diff])
        text = self.view[offset:offset + MAX_VIEW]
        rest = len(self.view) - offset - len(text)
        if rest > 0:
            text += f"\n[... {rest} more characters: read_more(offset={offset + len(text)})]"
        self.shown = self.base = key if offset == 0 and rest <= 0 and (brief or fresh) else ()
        return "\n".join(header + notes) + "\n\n" + text

    async def act(self, kind: str, ref: str, fn) -> str:
        """Run one action on the element `ref`, settle, and return the new view."""
        async with self.lock:
            await self.revive()
            element = await locate(self.page, ref)
            if element is None:
                return (f"No element {ref} on this page (refs change with every view).\n\n"
                        + await self.look(brief=True))
            started = time.monotonic()
            before = (self.page.url, self.view)
            try:
                await fn(element)
            except Exception as error:
                first = str(error).splitlines()[0][:300]
                self.trace.event(self.name, "action_error", action=kind, ref=ref, error=first)
                return f"{kind} {ref} failed: {first}\n\n" + await self.look(brief=True)
            await asyncio.sleep(0.25)
            await self.settle()
            self.trace.event(self.name, "action", action=kind, ref=ref, seconds=round(time.monotonic() - started, 2))
            view = await self.look(brief=True)

    async def _collect_closed(self, page: Page) -> None:
        for frame in page.frames:
            try:
                closed = await asyncio.wait_for(frame.evaluate("(window.__arClosed || []).splice(0)"),
                                                FRAME_SECONDS)
            except Exception:
                continue
            for title in closed:
                self.events.append(f"closed popup {title!r} with its close button")
                self.trace.event(self.name, "helper", action="close_popup", title=title)

    async def look(self, offset: int = 0, brief: bool = False, fresh: bool = False) -> str:
        """What the model sees: the helpers' events, the tab, then the page text with refs.

        After an action on the same page, only the changed lines are sent when that is much shorter: the model still
        has its latest full view (worker.py keeps it), and unchanged lines keep their refs. Only with `brief` (the
        browser tools, whose result the model gets as is). `fresh` marks a whole view the model now holds (a
        worker's first prompt); other callers (helpers that reshape the text) get it whole and reset the baseline.
        """
        await self.revive()
        page = self.page
        await self._collect_closed(page)
        self.stamp += 1
        if offset == 0:
            try:
                self.view = await observe(page, str(self.stamp))
            except Exception as error:
                await asyncio.sleep(1.0)
                try:
                    self.view = (await observe(page, str(self.stamp)) if not page.is_closed()
                                 else f"(page error {error})")
                except Exception as again:  # e.g. a script on the page hangs: the tab does not answer at all
                    self.view = f"(the page does not respond: {type(again).__name__} {str(again)[:160]})"
        try:
            title = await asyncio.wait_for(page.title(), FRAME_SECONDS)
        except Exception:
            title = ""
        header = [f"URL: {page.url}", f"Title: {title}"]
        notes = []
        if len(self.pages) > 1:
            notes.append(f"Windows open: {len(self.pages)} (you are in the newest)")
        if offset == 0 and page.url != self.last_url:
            self.last_url = page.url
            self.visits[page.url] = self.visits.get(page.url, 0) + 1
            if self.visits[page.url] >= LOOP_VISITS:  # a loop guard: paging back and forth finds nothing new
                notes.append(f"Note: you have arrived on this page {self.visits[page.url]} times; going back and "
                             f"forth between the same pages shows nothing new. Act on what this page offers (open "
                             f"an entry, its menu or its actions) or take another route.")
        if self.events:
            notes.append("Since your last action: " + "; ".join(self.events))
            self.events.clear()
        key = (page.url, title, self.view)
        if offset == 0 and brief and key == self.shown:
            return "\n".join([*notes, "The page is unchanged since your last action (same text and refs)."])
        if offset == 0:
            self.trace.event(self.name, "view", quiet=True, url=page.url, text=self.view)
            self.seen += "\n" + self.view
            same_page = brief and self.base and self.base[:2] == key[:2] and len(self.view) <= MAX_VIEW
            diff = changes(self.base[2], self.view) if same_page else None
            if diff is not None:
                self.shown = key
                return "\n".join([*notes, "The page changed. Against your latest full view of it, only these parts "
                                   "differ now (- was there, + is new); everything else, refs included, is as there:",
                                   diff])
        text = self.view[offset:offset + MAX_VIEW]
        rest = len(self.view) - offset - len(text)
        if rest > 0:
            text += f"\n[... {rest} more characters: read_more(offset={offset + len(text)})]"
        self.shown = self.base = key if offset == 0 and rest <= 0 and (brief or fresh) else ()
        return "\n".join(header + notes) + "\n\n" + text

"""
Dev check of the bid worker's position filling with a hand-made answer: never part of the package.

The answer file is JSON {"answer": <BidResult.answer() shape>, "attributes": {position: {name: value}}}. Keep such
files under dev/local/ (gitignored): they hold values read from the sites.

Live, on the scouting run: the agent's flow up to the signing page, in fresh browser contexts (the wizard keeps
its state per browser session, so other users do not interfere), stopped before the TAN request
(AGENT_STOP_BEFORE_SIGN=1) since TANs are shared; the trace shows the summary check:
    eval "$(atira scout --env)"; (cd agent && HEADLESS=1 uv run --no-sync python ../dev/configurator_check.py \\
        ../dev/local/answer.json)
Offline, against a local mock wizard (no logins, a fake mailbox that reads the mock's TAN from MOCK/_tan):
    (cd agent && uv run --no-sync python ../dev/configurator_check.py --mock http://127.0.0.1:8899/bid ANSWER.json)
"""
import asyncio
import json
import os
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.request import urlopen

AGENT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "agent"
sys.path.insert(0, str(AGENT))

import agent  # noqa: E402
import browsers  # noqa: E402
import run as contract  # noqa: E402
from briefing import Briefing  # noqa: E402
from browser_tools import SiteSession  # noqa: E402
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright  # noqa: E402
from submit import Mailbox, SigningTan, submit_bid  # noqa: E402
from tracing import Trace  # noqa: E402


def load(path: str) -> tuple[dict, dict]:
    file = Path(path) if Path(path).exists() else AGENT.parent / path  # else relative to the repo root
    data = json.loads(file.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    return data["answer"], data.get("attributes", {})


class MockMailbox(Mailbox):
    """Stands in for the webmail: the mock wizard exposes its current TAN."""

    def __init__(self, base: str):
        self.base, self.last_tan = base, ""

    async def address(self) -> str:
        return "bids@example.com"

    async def tan(self, answer: str = "") -> SigningTan | None:
        with urlopen(self.base + "/_tan") as response:
            tan = json.load(response)["tan"]
        return SigningTan(tan=tan, subject="Signing TAN", received="now") if tan else None


async def mock(url: str, path: str) -> None:
    answer, attributes = load(path)
    base = url.split("/bid")[0]
    briefing = Briefing(tender_reference=answer["tender_reference"], company_name="Example Hydraulics GmbH",
                        vat_id="DE000000000", scenario_date="2026-01-01", bid_site="bid", mail_site="mail",
                        submission_steps="Enter bidder details, the offer type, every item, the terms and the "
                                         "declarations, then sign with a TAN from your mailbox.")
    trace = Trace()
    async with async_playwright() as playwright:
        _, page = await browsers.connect(playwright)
        session = SiteSession({"siteId": "bid", "url": url, "credentials": {}}, page.context, trace)
        await session.start()
        started = time.monotonic()
        session.seen += "\nbids@example.com"
        result = await submit_bid(session, MockMailbox(base), briefing, time.monotonic() + 900, answer, attributes)
        print("RESULT", result, f"{time.monotonic() - started:.0f}s")
    with urlopen(base + "/_state") as response:
        print("STATE", json.dumps(json.load(response), indent=1))


async def live(path: str) -> int:
    """The agent's own flow with this answer, stopped before the TAN request (AGENT_STOP_BEFORE_SIGN=1)."""
    answer, attributes = load(path)
    task, _ = contract.load_run()

"""
Probe: walk the scouting tender portal's bid wizard in fresh contexts, omit every position, and record the
agent's view of every position page plus what position_on_page() says. Nothing is signed.
Usage (from agent/): eval "$(atira scout --env)"; HEADLESS=1 uv run --no-sync python PROBE.py OUTDIR N
"""
import asyncio
import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.cwd()))

import run as contract  # noqa: E402
from browser_tools import SiteSession  # noqa: E402
from configurator import position_on_page  # noqa: E402
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright  # noqa: E402
from tracing import Trace  # noqa: E402

OUT = Path(sys.argv[1])
OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
N = int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv) > 2 else 3
REF = sys.argv[3] if len(sys.argv) > 3 else ""


async def one(browser, task, k: int) -> None:
    site = next(s for s in task["access"] if "tender" in s["siteId"])
    context = await browser.new_context()
    session = SiteSession(site, context, Trace())
    await session.start()
    page = session.page
    base = site["url"].rstrip("/")
    await page.goto(f"{base}/tenders/{REF}/submission")
    await session.settle()
    await page.get_by_label(re.compile("Firmenname")).fill("Example GmbH")
    await page.get_by_label(re.compile("USt")).fill("DE000000000")
    await page.get_by_label(re.compile("E-Mail")).fill("user@example.com")
    await page.get_by_role("button", name=re.compile("^Weiter")).click()
    await session.settle()
    await page.get_by_label(re.compile("Angebotsart")).select_option(label="Hauptangebot")
    await page.get_by_role("button", name=re.compile("^Weiter")).click()
    await session.settle()
    for step in range(8):
        view = await session.look()
        (OUT / f"s{k}_p{step}.txt").write_text(view, encoding="utf-8")
        shown = re.findall(r"Position (\d\d\.\d\d)", view)
        if not shown:
            print(k, step, "no position; first lines:", view[:300].replace("\n", " | "))
            break
        pos = shown[0]
        print(k, step, pos, "on_page", position_on_page(view, pos), "all", sorted(set(shown)))
        omit = page.get_by_text(re.compile("Position auslassen"))
        box = page.get_by_role("checkbox", name=re.compile("auslassen"))
        if await box.count():
            await box.first.check()
            await page.get_by_role("button", name=re.compile("^Weiter")).click()
        else:
            await omit.first.click()
        await session.settle()
    await context.close()


async def main() -> None:
    task, _ = contract.load_run()
    async with async_playwright() as playwright:
        browser = await playwright.chromium.launch(headless=True)
        await asyncio.gather(*(one(browser, task, k) for k in range(N)), return_exceptions=False)
        await browser.close()


asyncio.run(main())

"""
Probe: walk the scouting tender portal's bid wizard in fresh contexts, omit every position, and record the
agent's view of every position page plus what position_on_page() says. Nothing is signed.
Usage (from agent/): eval "$(atira scout --env)"; HEADLESS=1 uv run --no-sync python PROBE.py OUTDIR N
"""
import asyncio
import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.cwd()))

import run as contract  # noqa: E402
from browser_tools import SiteSession  # noqa: E402
from configurator import position_on_page  # noqa: E402
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright  # noqa: E402
from tracing import Trace  # noqa: E402

OUT = Path(sys.argv[1])
OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
N = int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv) > 2 else 3
REF = sys.argv[3] if len(sys.argv) > 3 else ""


async def one(browser, task, k: int) -> None:
    site = next(s for s in task["access"] if "tender" in s["siteId"])
    context = await browser.new_context()
    session = SiteSession(site, context, Trace())
    await session.start()
    page = session.page
    base = site["url"].rstrip("/")
    await page.goto(f"{base}/tenders/{REF}/submission")
    await session.settle()
    await page.get_by_label(re.compile("Firmenname")).fill("Example GmbH")
    await page.get_by_label(re.compile("USt")).fill("DE000000000")
    await page.get_by_label(re.compile("E-Mail")).fill("user@example.com")
    await page.get_by_role("button", name=re.compile("^Weiter")).click()
    await session.settle()
    await page.get_by_label(re.compile("Angebotsart")).select_option(label="Hauptangebot")
    await page.get_by_role("button", name=re.compile("^Weiter")).click()
    await session.settle()
    for step in range(8):
        view = await session.look()
        (OUT / f"s{k}_p{step}.txt").write_text(view, encoding="utf-8")
        shown = re.findall(r"Position (\d\d\.\d\d)", view)
        if not shown:
            print(k, step, "no position; first lines:", view[:300].replace("\n", " | "))
            break
        pos = shown[0]
        print(k, step, pos, "on_page", position_on_page(view, pos), "all", sorted(set(shown)))
        omit = page.get_by_text(re.compile("Position auslassen"))
        box = page.get_by_role("checkbox", name=re.compile("auslassen"))
        if await box.count():
            await box.first.check()
            await page.get_by_role("button", name=re.compile("^Weiter")).click()
        else:
            await omit.first.click()
        await session.settle()
    await context.close()


async def main() -> None:
    task, _ = contract.load_run()
    async with async_playwright() as playwright:
        browser = await playwright.chromium.launch(headless=True)
        await asyncio.gather(*(one(browser, task, k) for k in range(N)), return_exceptions=False)
        await browser.close()


asyncio.run(main())

"""A run's trace: one JSON line per event in a file, and a short line on stdout for the run logs."""
import json
import os
import time
from pathlib import Path


CURRENT: "Trace | None" = None  # the run's trace, for the summary at the very end


def print_summary() -> None:
    """The current run's phase and failure events in one block (no-op before a trace exists)."""
    if CURRENT is not None:
        CURRENT.summary()


class Trace:
    def __init__(self, directory: str | None = None):
        global CURRENT
        CURRENT = self
        self.key: list[str] = []
        self.started = self.last = time.monotonic()
        directory = directory or os.environ.get("TRACE_DIR", "traces")
        Path(directory).mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        self.path = Path(directory) / time.strftime("run-%Y%m%d-%H%M%S.jsonl")
        self.file = self.path.open("a", encoding="utf-8")

    # events that mark a phase or a failure; repeated in one block at the end of the run (summary())
    KEY_KINDS = {"start", "done", "stopped", "problem", "start_failed", "spec_done", "tender_facts", "mail_kind",
                 "answer", "summary_check", "last_chance", "crashed", "decision_disputed", "helper_error"}

    def event(self, worker: str, kind: str, quiet: bool = False, **data) -> None:
        self.last = time.monotonic()
        seconds = round(self.last - self.started, 2)
        self.file.write(json.dumps({"t": seconds, "worker": worker, "kind": kind, **data}, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
        self.file.flush()
        if quiet:  # file only, e.g. the full page views
            return
        brief = " ".join(f"{k}={str(v)[:120]!r}" if isinstance(v, str) else f"{k}={v}" for k, v in data.items())
        print(f"[{seconds:7.1f}s] {worker:<15} {kind:<12} {brief}", flush=True)
        if kind in self.KEY_KINDS:
            self.key.append(f"[{seconds:7.1f}s] {worker:<15} {kind:<12} {brief[:150]}")

    def summary(self, limit: int = 120) -> None:
        """Print the phase and failure events again in one block: the platform keeps only the last few hundred
        lines of a run's output, so without this the early phases are missing from every run log."""
        lines = self.key if len(self.key) <= limit else self.key[:20] + ["  ..."] + self.key[-(limit - 21):]
        print("===== run summary =====\n" + "\n".join(lines) + "\n===== end of run summary =====", flush=True)

The bid worker runs in two phases: filling the form up to the signing step (plain navigation, thinking off by
default), then requesting the TAN, entering it and submitting. Between them one model call checks the
summary against the requirements; the signing phase thinks only when that check fails or finds problems.
THINKING_FORM, THINKING_REVIEW (the check) and THINKING_SIGN override these defaults (see llm.thinking).

class MailboxAddress(BaseModel):

class SigningTan(BaseModel):

    subject: str
    received: str = Field(description="When the message arrived, as shown")

    open_points: str = Field(description="Anything you could not enter or that the page still asks for; '' if none")


class SubmissionResult(BaseModel):
    submitted: bool = Field(description="True only when the website confirmed the bid as submitted")
    confirmation: str = Field(description="The website's confirmation or error text, word for word")

live = [c for c in changes if c.position == position and c.number not in gone
            and (scenario_date is None or _not_later(c.date, scenario_date))]
    if not live:
        return tender_quantity
    return max(live, key=lambda c: (_order(c.date), position_key(c.number))).quantity


def to_pieces(quantity: int, unit: Unit, pieces_per_set: int | None) -> int:
    """Rule 17: Satz x pieces per set; pieces stay as they are."""
    if unit is Unit.PIECE:
        return quantity
    if not pieces_per_set:
        raise CalcError("quantity in sets but pieces per set unknown")
    return quantity * pieces_per_set


class Amendment(BaseModel):
    """A scoped technical amendment from the tender Q&A (rule 14)."""
    date: Stamp
    revision: str
    requirement: str

class CurrentRevision(BaseModel):
    revision: str = Field(description="The revision the site marks as currently valid, exactly as shown")
    why: str = Field(description="What on the page marks it as current, in a few words")


class Opened(BaseModel):
    done: bool = Field(description="True once read_document has read the requested revision")


class RequirementSeen(BaseModel):
    requirement_id: str = Field(description="The requirement's reference as shown")
    bore: str = Field(description="Bore in mm, exactly as shown")
    stroke: str = Field(description="Stroke (travel) in mm, exactly as shown")
    pressure: str = Field(description="Operating pressure in bar, exactly as shown")
    mounting: str = Field(description="Mounting type as written")
    certification: str = Field(description="Required certification as written, or the words saying none is "
                                           "required")
    catalog_group: str = Field(description="The Kataloggruppe (catalogue group code) named for the ERP search")
    pieces_per_set: str = Field("", description="Pieces per set (Satz) if the text defines a set, else ''")
    stroke_is_usable_travel: bool = Field(description="True if the stroke is stated as usable travel (nutzbarer "
                                                      "Weg) to which a reserve must be added for the ERP stroke")
    reserve_key: str = Field("", description="The key of that end reserve, if named, else ''")
    conflict: str = Field("", description="Only if the table and the full wording disagree: how; else ''")


class SpecPage(BaseModel):
    revision_shown: str = Field(description="The revision this page belongs to, as shown on it, or ''")
    requirements: list[RequirementSeen]


    return history if history.revisions else None


def _record_views(session: SiteSession) -> dict[str, str]:
    """Every distinct page text the session shows, latest last (a document viewer may page inside one URL)."""
    views: dict[str, str] = {}
    look = session.look

    async def recording_look(offset: int = 0, **options) -> str:
        out = await look(offset, **options)
        if offset == 0:
            text = _strip_refs(session.view)
            key = f"{session.page.url}#{hash(text)}"
            views.pop(key, None)

def to_pieces(quantity: int, unit: Unit, pieces_per_set: int | None) -> int:
    """Rule 17: Satz x pieces per set; pieces stay as they are."""

def parse_unit(text: str) -> Unit:
    """Map a stated unit (Stück, St, ST, pcs, Satz, Sätze, Set) to a Unit."""
    t = text.strip().lower().rstrip(".")
    if t.startswith(("satz", "sätz", "saetz", "set")):
        return Unit.SET
    if t in {"st", "stk", "stck", "stück", "stueck", "pc", "pcs", "piece", "pieces"}:
        return Unit.PIECE
    raise CalcError(f"unknown unit {text!r}")

    """What the order-level discount applies to for one position (rule 12; setup is never discounted)."""

def parse_unit(text: str) -> Unit:
    """Map a stated unit (Stück, St, ST, pcs, Satz, Sätze, Set) to a Unit."""
    t = text.strip().lower().rstrip(".")
    if t.startswith(("satz", "sätz", "saetz", "set")):

    if t in {"st", "stk", "stck", "stück", "stueck", "pc", "pcs", "piece", "pieces"}:

    if len(named) == 1 and named[0] in shown:

    if len(shown) == 1:
        return shown[0], shown
    if len(named) == 1 and not shown:

    return None, shown

return (self.configure_position, self.net_total) if self.entries else ()

    async def configure_position(self, ctx: RunContext[Deps], position: str, fields: dict[str, str] | None = None,
                                 confirm_button: str = "", next_button: str = "",
                                 choices: dict[str, str] | None = None) -> str:
        """
        Enter all values of the position the form shows now and, once all are in, save it and go on with the form's
        next/continue button. `position`: its number as the page shows it. `fields`: control label (exactly as in
        your view) -> value name; needed on the first call, later calls reuse it. `confirm_button`: label of the
        button that applies a choice so the next choice opens. `next_button`: label of the button that saves the
        position and goes on (never the one that omits or adds a position); needed once. `choices`: only when a
        call reported that no option equals an attribute: control label -> the option that means the same.
        """
        session, plan, asked = ctx.deps.session, self.plan, position.strip()

        def refuse(reason: str, text: str) -> str:  # every early return is traced: the run logs show why
            session.trace.event(session.name, "configure_refused", position=asked, reason=reason,
                                fields=fields or {}, text=text[:300])
            return text

        known = set().union(*self.entries.values()) - {"position"}
        if fields:  # later calls add to or correct the mapping, they never drop what was mapped before
            given = {label: name.strip() for label, name in fields.items()}
            unknown = sorted({name for name in given.values() if name not in known})
            if unknown:  # drop only the unknown names; the rest of the mapping still counts
                given = {label: name for label, name in given.items() if name in known}
            plan.fields = {label: name for label, name in plan.fields.items() if name not in given.values()}
            plan.fields.update(given)
            if unknown and not plan.fields:
                return refuse("unknown_names", f"Unknown value names {unknown}; use only: "
                                               f"{', '.join(sorted(known))}. Call again.")
        if confirm_button:
            plan.confirm = confirm_button
        if next_button:
            self.next_button = next_button
        async with session.lock:
            view = await session.look()
            position, shown = resolve_position(asked, self.entries, view)
            if position is None or position not in shown:  # a page between two states: look again once settled
                await session.settle()
                view = await session.look()
                position, shown = resolve_position(asked, self.entries, view)
        if position is None:
            if shown:  # several of the bid's positions on one page: the model must name one of them
                return refuse("ambiguous", f"Name the position this page is about by its own number (one of "
                                           f"{', '.join(shown)}), then call again.")
            return refuse("no_values", f"No values for position {asked!r} (the page shows none of this bid's "
                                       f"positions {', '.join(sorted(self.entries, key=position_key))}): leave it "
                                       f"out with the form's option to omit a position. {self.so_far(session)}")
        if position not in shown:
            return refuse("not_on_page", f"Position {position} is not on the page now"
                                         + (f" (the page shows {', '.join(shown)})" if shown else "")
                                         + ". Configure the position the page shows, by its own number.")
        entry = self.entries[position]
        if not plan.fields:
            return refuse("no_fields", f"Position {position} has values to enter. Give fields (control label -> "
                                       f"value name) for the controls of this form, then call again; do not omit it.")
        if self.failures.get(position, 0) >= 3:
            return refuse("failed", f"Position {position} failed three times: leave it out with the form's option "
                                    f"to omit a position. {self.so_far(session)}")
        if time.monotonic() > self.deadline - SIGNING_RESERVE:
            return refuse("time", "Time is short: leave this and every remaining position out and go on to "
                                  "signing. " + self.so_far(session))
        async with session.lock:
            log: list[str] = []
            try:
                remembered = self.choices.setdefault(position, {})
                remembered.update(choices or {})  # a revisit of the position needs the same picks
                error = await fill_position(session, entry, plan, log, remembered)
            except Exception as exc:  # a slow or changed page: the model decides to retry or omit
                error = f"{type(exc).__name__}: {str(exc).splitlines()[0][:200]}"
            moved = ""
            if not error and self.next_button:  # the model named the button; clicking it is the mechanical part
                view = await session.look()
                ref, why = find_control(view, self.next_button, ("button",))
                target = await locate(session.page, ref) if ref else None
                if target is None:
                    moved = f" Could not save it: {why}; click the form's next/continue button yourself."
                else:
                    await target.click(timeout=5000)
                    await session.settle()
                    moved = f" Saved with {self.next_button!r}; the page below is the form's next step."
            session.trace.event(session.name, "configure_position", position=position, done=log, error=error,
                                moved=moved)
            view = await session.look()
        if error:
            self.failures[position] = self.failures.get(position, 0) + 1
            self.entered.discard(position)
            return (f"Position {position} not fully entered: {error}. Entered so far: {'; '.join(log) or 'nothing'}. "
                    "Fix the mapping and call again, or leave the position out with the form's option to omit "
                    f"it. {self.so_far(session)}\n\n{view}")
        self.entered.add(position)
        then = moved or " Check it, then save and continue with the form's next/continue button."
        return f"Position {position} entered: {'; '.join(log)}.{then} {self.so_far(session)}\n\n{view}"

    def so_far(self, session: SiteSession) -> str:
        """The running net total, told after every position so the totals step needs no arithmetic."""
        total = german(self.total())
        session.seen += "\n" + total  # our own figure: let the worker's result mention it
        entered = ", ".join(sorted(self.entered, key=position_key)) or "none"

"""Form-filling helpers on invented options and labels."""
import sys
import unittest
from decimal import Decimal as D
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent))

from configurator import (  # noqa: E402
    complete_positions,
    controls,
    find_control,
    form_value,
    german,
    match_option,
    parse_number,
    position_on_page,
)


def opts(*texts, values=None):
    values = values or texts
    return [{"value": "", "text": "Choose"}] + [{"value": v, "text": t} for t, v in zip(texts, values, strict=True)]


class Numbers(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_parse(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_number("1.234,56"), D("1234.56"))
        self.assertEqual(parse_number("1,234.56"), D("1234.56"))
        self.assertEqual(parse_number("12,5"), D("12.5"))
        self.assertEqual(parse_number("7"), D("7"))
        self.assertIsNone(parse_number("AB-12"))

    def test_german(self):
        self.assertEqual(german(1234.5), "1234,50")
        self.assertEqual(german(D("0.005")), "0,01")  # HALF_UP
        self.assertEqual(german(5, 0), "5")
        self.assertEqual(form_value("unit_price", 3.1), "3,10")
        self.assertEqual(form_value("quantity", 40), "40")
        self.assertEqual(form_value("mounting", "Clevis"), "Clevis")


class Options(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_text_sorted_numbers_match_by_value(self):
        options = opts("10", "100", "12", "120", "16", "8")
        self.assertEqual(match_option(options, "12")[0]["value"], "12")
        self.assertEqual(match_option(options, "8")[0]["value"], "8")
        self.assertIsNone(match_option(options, "11")[0])

    def test_number_with_unit(self):
        options = opts("1 week", "2 weeks", "12 weeks", "21 weeks")
        self.assertEqual(match_option(options, "2")[0]["text"], "2 weeks")
        self.assertEqual(match_option(options, "12")[0]["text"], "12 weeks")

    def test_catalogue_number_with_details(self):
        options = opts("XY-100 · 160 bar", "XY-1000 · 250 bar", "XY-100-B · 160 bar", values=["a", "b", "c"])
        self.assertEqual(match_option(options, "XY-100")[0]["value"], "a")
        self.assertEqual(match_option(options, "XY-1000")[0]["value"], "b")

    def test_text_and_value(self):
        options = opts("Without approval", "Type A", values=["none", "a"])
        self.assertEqual(match_option(options, "none")[0]["text"], "Without approval")
        self.assertEqual(match_option(options, "type a")[0]["value"], "a")
        self.assertIsNone(match_option(options, "Type")[0])  # a word of an option is not the option

    def test_placeholder_never_matches(self):
        self.assertIsNone(match_option(opts("Red"), "Choose")[0])


VIEW = """## Item 2.10
[e3 select "Diameter (mm)" selected="Choose" options: Choose | 10 | 8]
[e4 select "Length" selected="Choose" disabled options: Choose]
[e5 button "Apply choice"]
[e6 textbox "Qty (pcs)" value=""]
[e7 textbox "Net unit price (EUR)" value=""]
[e8 textbox "Unit price before discount (EUR)" value=""]
[e9 button "Add item"]"""


class Controls(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_find(self):
        self.assertEqual([c[0] for c in controls(VIEW)], ["e3", "e4", "e5", "e6", "e7", "e8", "e9"])
        self.assertEqual(find_control(VIEW, "Length")[0], "e4")
        self.assertEqual(find_control(VIEW, "qty (pcs)")[0], "e6")
        self.assertEqual(find_control(VIEW, "Apply choice", ("button",))[0], "e5")
        self.assertIsNone(find_control(VIEW, "unit price")[0])  # two labels contain it
        self.assertEqual(find_control(VIEW, "Net unit price (EUR)")[0], "e7")

    def test_position_on_page(self):
        self.assertTrue(position_on_page(VIEW, "2.10"))
        self.assertFalse(position_on_page(VIEW, "2.1"))
        self.assertFalse(position_on_page(VIEW, "10"))


class Positions(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_complete_only(self):
        answer = {"decision": "bid", "positions": [
            {"position": "1", "material_number": "M-1", "quantity": 5, "unit_price": 2.5, "lead_time_weeks": 3,
             "base_unit_price": 2.0},

class CentAllocation(StrEnum):
    """
    How the setup pool fee is split into cents (rule 25: the rule is stated in the Ruestpools mail).

    LARGEST_REMAINDER: floor every exact share, hand out the missing cents by largest fractional part.
    ROUND_EACH: round every share HALF_UP, no correction (the sum may differ from the fee by a few cents).
    REST_TO_LARGEST / REST_TO_FIRST / REST_TO_LAST: round (or floor, see SetupPool.rest_base) every share, then the
    difference to the fee goes to the member with the largest weight / the first / the last member by tie order.
    """
    LARGEST_REMAINDER = "largest_remainder"
    ROUND_EACH = "round_each"
    REST_TO_LARGEST = "rest_to_largest"
    REST_TO_FIRST = "rest_to_first"
    REST_TO_LAST = "rest_to_last"


class TieOrder(StrEnum):
    ASCENDING = "ascending"
    DESCENDING = "descending"

class AnswerPosition(BaseModel):
    position: str
    material_number: str
    quantity: int
    unit_price: Decimal
    lead_time_weeks: int
    base_unit_price: Decimal | None = None
    surcharge_per_unit: Decimal | None = None
    packaging_per_unit: Decimal | None = None
    rebate_total: Decimal | None = None
def calculate(bid: BidInput) -> BidResult:
    """Apply the bid rules to established facts and return the answer with intermediates."""
    missing = [p.position for p in bid.positions if p.material is None]
    if missing:
        return BidResult(tender_reference=bid.tender_reference, decision="no_bid", positions=[],
                         discount_percent=effective_discount(bid.approval, None), total_net=Decimal("0.00"),
                         missing_materials=missing)

    pieces = {p.position: to_pieces(p.quantity, p.unit, p.pieces_per_set) for p in bid.positions}
    pooled: dict[str, int] = defaultdict(int)
    for p in bid.positions:
        pooled[p.material.material_number] += pieces[p.position]  # type: ignore[union-attr]

    base: dict[str, tuple[Decimal, PriceScale, PriceCondition, Decimal]] = {
        p.position: _base_eur(p, pieces[p.position], bid) for p in bid.positions}
    rates = {p.position: _metal_rate(p.material, bid) for p in bid.positions}  # type: ignore[arg-type]
    surcharge = {p.position: p.material.surcharge_mass * rates[p.position] for p in bid.positions}  # type: ignore

    order_value = money(sum((pieces[k] * base[k][0] for k in pieces), Decimal(0)))
    discount = effective_discount(bid.approval, order_value)
    factor = 1 - discount / HUNDRED

    pool: dict[str, Decimal] = {}
    if bid.setup_pool is not None:
        by_pos = {p.position: p for p in bid.positions}
        weights = {m: pieces[m] * by_pos[m].material.allocation_mass  # type: ignore[union-attr]
                   for m in bid.setup_pool.members if m in by_pos}
        if weights:
            pool = allocate_cents(bid.setup_pool.fee, weights, bid.setup_pool.allocation, bid.setup_pool.tie_order,
                                  bid.setup_pool.rest_base)

    bonus: dict[str, Decimal] = {}
    bonus_total = None
    if bid.project_bonus is not None:
        goods = {}
        for p in bid.positions:
            if p.position in bid.project_bonus.members:
                unit = base[p.position][0] + (surcharge[p.position] if bid.project_bonus.include_surcharge else 0)
                goods[p.position] = pieces[p.position] * unit
        bonus_total = bonus_credit(money(sum(goods.values(), Decimal(0))), bid.project_bonus.bands)
        if goods and bonus_total > 0:
            bonus = allocate_cents(bonus_total, goods)

    positions, debug = [], []
    for p in bid.positions:
        k, material, n = p.position, p.material, pieces[p.position]
        assert material is not None
        base_eur, scale, cond, fx = base[k]
        f_base = factor if p.discount_scope is not DiscountScope.NONE else Decimal(1)
        f_sur = factor if p.discount_scope is DiscountScope.BASE_AND_SURCHARGE else Decimal(1)
        if n == 0:
            raise CalcError(f"{k}: zero pieces")
        cartons, carton_cost = 0, Decimal(0)
        if p.packaging is not None:
            if not material.pieces_per_carton:
                raise CalcError(f"{k}: carton size unknown")
            cartons = math.ceil(n / material.pieces_per_carton)
            carton_cost = cartons * p.packaging.price_per_carton
        setup = p.setup_fee + pool.get(k, Decimal(0))
        credit = bonus.get(k, Decimal(0))
        exact = base_eur * f_base + surcharge[k] * f_sur + (setup + carton_cost - credit) / n
        positions.append(AnswerPosition(
            position=k, material_number=material.material_number, quantity=n, unit_price=money(exact),
            lead_time_weeks=lead_time(p, pooled[material.material_number]), base_unit_price=base_eur,
            surcharge_per_unit=money(surcharge[k] + setup / n), packaging_per_unit=money(carton_cost / n),
            rebate_total=money(credit)))
        debug.append(PositionDebug(
            position=k, pieces=n, pooled_demand=pooled[material.material_number], scale_min_quantity=scale.min_quantity,
            scale_price=scale.price, currency=cond.currency, fx_rate=fx, base_eur=base_eur, metal_rate=rates[k],
            mass_surcharge=surcharge[k], discount_factor_base=f_base, discount_factor_surcharge=f_sur,
            setup_fee=p.setup_fee, pool_allocation=pool.get(k, Decimal(0)), cartons=cartons, carton_cost=carton_cost,
            bonus=credit, unit_price_exact=exact))

    total = money(sum((p.quantity * p.unit_price for p in positions), Decimal(0)))
    return BidResult(tender_reference=bid.tender_reference, decision="bid", discount_percent=discount,
                     positions=positions, total_net=total, order_value=order_value, bonus_total=bonus_total,
                     debug=debug)

1	"""
2	Evidence records the research workers produce, and their mapping onto calc's input models.
3	
4	Workers copy values exactly as the pages show them (raw strings, which the grounding check can verify); the parsing
5	here is deterministic: locale-tagged numbers ("1.234,50 (de-DE)", "12,345 (en-US)"), dates in several orders,
6	masses with units, lead times in weeks. Exact attribute matching is a validator over the model-collected facts.
7	"""
8	import re
9	from datetime import date, datetime
10	from decimal import Decimal, InvalidOperation
11	
12	from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
13	
14	import calc
15	
16	# ---------------------------------------------------------------- parsing
17	
18	
19	class ParseError(ValueError):
20	    pass
21	
22	
23	_TAG = re.compile(r"\(\s*([a-z]{2})[-_]([A-Z]{2})\s*\)")
24	_NUM = re.compile(r"[-+]?\d[\d.,'   ]*")
25	
26	
27	def number_format(text: str, fallback: str | None = None) -> str | None:
28	    """The locale a value is written in: its own tag "(de-DE)", else the fallback (e.g. the record's format)."""
29	    tag = _TAG.search(text or "")
30	    if tag:
31	        return tag.group(1).lower()
32	    if fallback:
33	        m = re.search(r"([a-z]{2})(?:[-_][A-Za-z]{2})?", fallback.strip(), re.IGNORECASE)
34	        return m.group(1).lower() if m else None
35	    return None
36	
37	
38	def parse_number(text: str, fmt: str | None = None) -> Decimal:
39	    """
40	    A number as a page writes it. `fmt` is a language code or locale ("de", "en-US") when the text carries no tag.
41	
42	    Without any format: both separators -> the last one is decimal; a single comma or dot followed by exactly three
43	    digits is a thousands separator only for "en"/"de" respectively, otherwise German pages default to comma decimal.
44	    """
45	    if text is None:
46	        raise ParseError("no value")
47	    lang = number_format(text, fmt)
48	    body = _TAG.sub("", str(text))
49	    m = _NUM.search(body)
50	    if not m:
51	        raise ParseError(f"no number in {text!r}")
52	    raw = re.sub(r"['   ]", "", m.group(0)).rstrip(".,")
53	    if lang == "en":
54	        raw = raw.replace(",", "")
55	    elif lang in ("de", "fr", "es", "it", "nl", "pt"):
56	        raw = raw.replace(".", "").replace(",", ".")
57	    elif "," in raw and "." in raw:
58	        if raw.rfind(",") > raw.rfind("."):
59	            raw = raw.replace(".", "").replace(",", ".")
60	        else:
61	            raw = raw.replace(",", "")
62	    elif "," in raw:
63	        raw = raw.replace(",", ".") if raw.count(",") == 1 else raw.replace(",", "")
64	    elif raw.count(".") > 1:
65	        raw = raw.replace(".", "")
66	    try:
67	        return Decimal(raw)
68	    except InvalidOperation as error:
69	        raise ParseError(f"cannot read {text!r}") from error
70	
71	
72	def parse_int(text: str, fmt: str | None = None) -> int:
73	    value = parse_number(text, fmt)
74	    if value != value.to_integral_value():
75	        raise ParseError(f"{text!r} is not a whole number")
76	    return int(value)

"""Parsing of values the workers copy from pages, on invented wordings."""
import sys
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent))

from evidence import ParseError, parse_pieces_per_set  # noqa: E402


class PiecesPerSet(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_plain(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_pieces_per_set("4"), 4)
        self.assertEqual(parse_pieces_per_set("4 Stück"), 4)
        self.assertEqual(parse_pieces_per_set("6 pieces per kit"), 6)

    def test_definition_counts_the_pieces_not_the_set(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_pieces_per_set("1 Satz = 4 Stück"), 4)
        self.assertEqual(parse_pieces_per_set("2 sets = 12 pcs"), 6)
        self.assertEqual(parse_pieces_per_set("1 set: 3 pieces"), 3)
        self.assertEqual(parse_pieces_per_set("8 Stück je 1 Satz"), 8)
        self.assertEqual(parse_pieces_per_set("Satz zu 7 Stück"), 7)

    def test_unclear(self):
        for text in ("2 = 3", "3 Stück, 4 Stück", "1 2 3", "ein Satz"):
            with self.assertRaises(ParseError, msg=text):
                parse_pieces_per_set(text)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
